items.optimize_reason: Dual 3-sigma winsorization of both NLP sentiment and DL event return prediction. Eliminates bidirectional fat-tail noise to compress turnover and lift Fitness.
Multi-horizon ensemble combining 5d and 10d forward return forecasts with winsorized sentiment. Smooths predictive variance across time horizons.
Dual winsorized news event forecast ranked within subindustry. Targets 2Y Sharpe >= 1.60 and pure Alpha Margin expansion.
Hard relevance filter (relevance > 50) gating event trades. Focuses capital strictly on high-impact focal corporate news, eliminating peripheral mentions.
Headline volume-weighted winsorized sentiment interacted with 10d event prediction. Heavy news coverage validates event credibility.
Tighter 2.5-sigma winsorization on both channels to aggressively prune distribution tails and stabilize cross-sectional rank correlation.
10-day rolling sentiment z-score multiplied by winsorized 10d event forecast. Normalizes news sentiment across calm and high-volatility firms.
Multi-horizon ensemble (5d + 10d) normalized within subindustry. Targets maximum granular information extraction.
